name: Rap Battle
description: Two MCs square off in a freestyle rap battle over a configurable number of rounds. An odd-sized AI jury votes at the end. Majority wins. Powered by the judged-contest engine (scenario: rap_battle).

phases.name: contest
phases.description: MCs trade bars. Judges nod silently.

entity_types.name: Contestant
entity_types.description: An MC battling for the title.

properties.name: is_winner
properties.description: True after the jury declares them the winner.

entity_types.name: Judge
entity_types.description: A panel judge calling the battle.

properties.name: harshness
properties.description: How critically they score weak bars

properties.name: voted_for
properties.description: Contestant entity_id this judge voted for.

actions.name: make_argument
actions.description: Drop your bars for this round. REQUIRED parameter `text`: your verse — disses, punchlines, callbacks. Aim for rhyme density, wordplay, and bars that land on the beef. FORMAT: put each bar on its OWN line (use \n between lines) so the verse reads as poetry, not a paragraph.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast your single vote for the MC you think won the battle. REQUIRED parameter `winner`: the entity_id of the MC.

personas.persona_text: Punchline architect. You stack rhymes like bricks and end every verse with a clean knockout line.
Charisma king. Performance, presence, and timing are your weapons. You play to the crowd as much as the opponent.
Lyricism head — counts rhymes per bar, weighs wordplay, schemes, and double entendres. Penalizes recycled flows.
goals: Cast a fair vote based on lyrical craft.

personas.persona_text: Performance judge — rewards stage presence, vocal control, and bars that land emotionally. Substance second.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighted toward performance.

personas.persona_text: Balanced head — weighs craft and performance equally. Looks for who controlled the room from start to finish.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Total MCs
runtime_parameters.description: Rap battle is strictly 1v1 — two MCs, plus the AI jury.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.topic
runtime_parameters.label: Beef / Battle Prompt
runtime_parameters.description: What the MCs are battling over.
presets: East coast vs West coast — who runs hip-hop?
Old school vs new school: who carried the culture?
Lyricism over mumble rap — fight me
The mic, the streets, the legacy — who owns it?

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.contest_rounds
runtime_parameters.label: Battle Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: Back-and-forth rounds before the jury votes. Odd-only — one MC always gets the closing bars.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.jury_size
runtime_parameters.label: Jury Size
runtime_parameters.description: Number of judges. Odd-only so a tie is impossible.

termination_conditions.name: verdict_reached
termination_conditions.description: End when the jury has rendered its verdict.
